columns.name: Basic Information
columns.valueCondition:
const info = this.trainingBasicInformation || {}; let htmlString = `
${info.traningtitle || 'N/A'}
Category: ${info.category || 'N/A'}
Training Type: ${info.trainingtype || 'N/A'}
Duration: ${info.duration !== undefined ? info.duration + ' Days' : 'N/A'}
Max Participants: ${info.maxparticipants !== undefined ? info.maxparticipants : 'N/A'}
`; return htmlString;

function formatDate(dateString) { if (!dateString) return "N/A"; const date = new Date(dateString); if (isNaN(date)) return "N/A"; return date.toLocaleDateString("en-GB", { day: "2-digit", month: "short", year: "numeric" }); } function formatTime(timeString) { if (!timeString) return "N/A"; if (/^\d{1,2}:\d{2}$/.test(timeString)) { const [hours, minutes] = timeString.split(":").map(Number); const date = new Date(); date.setHours(hours, minutes, 0, 0); return date.toLocaleTimeString("en-US", { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hour12: true }); } const date = new Date(timeString); if (!isNaN(date)) { return date.toLocaleTimeString("en-US", { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hour12: true }); } return "N/A"; } const scheduleData = this.trainingScheduleAndVenue || {}; const scheduleList = scheduleData.trainingSchedule || []; let htmlString = `
Date: ${formatDate(scheduleData.startDate)} - ${formatDate(scheduleData.enddate)}
Venue: ${scheduleData.venue || "N/A"}
Schedule: ${scheduleList.length > 0 ? `
    ${ scheduleList.map(item => `
  • ${(item.schedule || "").charAt(0).toUpperCase() + (item.schedule || "").slice(1).toLowerCase()} - ${formatTime(item.time)}
    • `).join("")}
` : "N/A"}
`; return htmlString;
